```yaml
name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: 'Select deployment platform'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - modal
          - railway
          - fly
          - render
          - daytona
        default: modal

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true

      - name: Install Modal CLI
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'modal' }}
        run: pip install modal

      - name: Install Railway CLI
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'railway' }}
        run: npm install -g railway

      - name: Install Flyctl
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'fly' }}
        run: |
          curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.fly/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install Daytona CLI
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'daytona' }}
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/daytonaio/cli/releases/latest/download/daytona-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/daytona

      - name: Deploy to Modal
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'modal' }}
        run: bash distributed/deploy/modal-deploy.sh

      - name: Deploy to Railway
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'railway' }}
        run: |
          railway init --yes
          railway up --yes

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'fly' }}
        run: bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh

      - name: Deploy to Render
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'render' }}
        run: echo "Render deployment is triggered via button; no CLI command available."

      - name: Deploy to Daytona
        if: ${{ inputs.platform == 'daytona' }}
        run: daytona create

      - name: Verify /health endpoint
        run: |
          echo "Verifying /health endpoint..."
          curl -sSf http://localhost:8000/health || echo "Health check failed"
```
